canonical_text_stream: Load the 36,718 train rows in parquet order, preserve the released filter/map behavior, strip each text value, join with two newline characters, and tokenize once with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct revision a09a35458c702b33eeacc393d103063234e8bc28.
selection_rule: Before data loading, seed Python random, NumPy, PyTorch and Transformers with 0. For draw indices 0 through 127, use random.randint(0, token_count - 2048 - 1) and take the contiguous half-open token window [start,start+2048). Preserve draw order and duplicates exactly as released code.
paper_role: The same 128 windows supply the layerwise full-precision targets and quantized inputs for 15 epochs of FlatQuant affine-transformation and clipping calibration.
